scripts.dev: concurrently -n portfolio,admin -c green,blue "npm run dev:portfolio" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:portfolio && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:portfolio: npm run build --workspace=@portfolio/database && npm run build --workspace=@portfolio/ai && npm run build --workspace=portfolio
scripts.build:admin: npm run build --workspace=@portfolio/database && npm run build --workspace=@portfolio/ai && npm run build --workspace=admin
